transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I guess... well, my boss told me I needed to come. I've been having some trouble at work lately. I'm an electrician, and... I just can't seem to keep my focus on one thing. Like, I'll be looking at an estimate or a code form, and then... I don't know, a tool drops, or my phone buzzes, or I just get this idea about how to reorganize the workshop. And then I'm off doing that, and... the jobs are just getting all mixed up.
Have you noticed this kind of difficulty staying focused going back to when you were a kid or teenager, or is this something that's really only started recently?

No, it's... it's not from when I was a kid. It's just recently. Um, I guess it's been building up for about seven months or so. Right around the time we took out the mortgage for the new workshop and all the equipment. Just... since then, really.
Along with this trouble focusing, have you noticed periods where you feel unusually energetic, elated, or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?

I guess... yeah, sometimes. I get pretty fired up. Like, I'll get this feeling that we're about to be the biggest solar outfit in the area, and I'll start talking it up. But... well, if my wife or one of the guys at the shop questions it, I don't know. I just kind of snap. I get pretty sharp with them over nothing. So, yeah, I guess my mood gets a bit... intense.
Over these past seven months, have you been using alcohol, stimulants, or any recreational drugs more than usual?
No, I haven't. I mean, I'll have a beer sometimes after work, but... that's it. Nothing else.

Before these past seven months, have you ever had a period—weeks or longer—where you felt unusually low, sad, or lost interest in things, or another time where you felt unusually high or energetic like this?
No, I don't think so. I mean, not that I can remember. Things were just... normal before all this started.
During this period, has this elevated, fired-up mood and reduced need for sleep lasted continuously for a week or more at a time, or does it come and go within a day?

I don't really know. I'm not... tracking it on a calendar or anything. It just sort of happens. I guess it sticks around for a bit, but... I couldn't tell you if it's a whole week straight. It's just hard to say.

During this period when you felt fired up and needed less sleep, did it get bad enough that it seriously disrupted your work, relationships, or daily functioning—or did anyone suggest you needed hospitalization or urgent help because of it?

I mean... work's been a little tense lately. Some clients complained about... I don't know, scheduling stuff. Missed details. And the guys I train, my apprentices, they're... questioning me more. 

And at home... well, my wife and I have been arguing a lot. Mostly about the mortgage and the business. She thinks I'm... putting things at risk. But nobody said anything about a hospital.
I don't know. I'm not really sure what you're asking. I haven't noticed anything like that.
During these fired-up periods, have you made any big purchases, taken out loans, or made major business decisions impulsively—things you might not have done otherwise?
I mean... I don't think so. Not really. I'm just running my business. I haven't done anything crazy. Just normal stuff.
During these fired-up periods, do you notice your thoughts racing very quickly, or find that your mind jumps rapidly from one idea to another so fast it's hard to keep up?
No, I don't... I don't think so. My mind's just on my work. I have a lot of jobs to plan out, so I'm thinking about those. But it's not... I can keep up fine.
Over these past seven months, has this fired-up, intense mood been pretty much constant, or do you notice it comes and goes—sometimes feeling low or down in between the high periods?
I'm not really sure. I don't think I've felt low or anything. It's just been... pretty steady, I guess. Like I said, I'm just busy working. I don't really have time to sit around feeling down.
Would your wife or the guys at work say that this fired-up, intense mood is a clear change from how you normally are, or would they say you've always been kind of like this?
I don't know. You'd have to ask them. I'm just... I'm just doing my job. I don't really pay attention to what they think about my mood.

Before these last seven months, going back over the past couple of years, did you notice your mood or energy repeatedly swinging between these fired-up periods and times of feeling more down or low, even if not as intense as now?
No... I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't keep track of my moods or anything. I've just been working, mostly. Everything's just been normal, as far as I know.
During these fired-up stretches, are you actually sleeping fewer hours than usual and still waking up feeling rested and full of energy, or are you just staying up later to get more work done?

I guess I don't sleep much. Maybe three or four hours a night, for a while now. But I feel fine. I wake up before the sun's up and I'm just... ready to go. I start pricing out materials, doing emails, sketching out systems. I don't feel tired, if that's what you mean. It feels like a full night's sleep to me.

During these fired-up periods, have you had any experiences like hearing voices others don't hear, or believing things about yourself—like having special abilities or connections—that others found hard to believe or told you weren't true?
No, nothing like that. I don't hear things. And I don't think I have any... special abilities or whatever. I'm just an electrician. I just do my job.
